name: PaymentExecution
description: Represents the FPS scheme-level execution record for a Faster Payment. Created by SVC-009 (Domestic Payments) when it submits and receives acceptance from Pay.UK/Vocalink. Contains the FPS end-to-end reference (fps_reference), settlement status, and submission timestamps. This entity is the authoritative record of the payment's scheme-level status and the primary source of the fps_reference shown to the customer on their confirmation screen. Introduced by JRN-002.

fields.name: payment_execution_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated by SVC-009. Internal identifier. Immutable.

fields.name: payment_intent_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → PaymentIntent.payment_intent_id. Links execution to originating instruction. Immutable.

fields.name: fps_reference
fields.validation_rule: Required on acceptance. FPS end-to-end identifier assigned by Vocalink. Unique across FPS scheme. Max 35 characters (ISO 20022 EndToEndId). Immutable.
fields.transparency_note: Surfaced to PER-001 on the payment confirmation screen as the payment reference. Used by both the sending and receiving banks for payment tracing.

fields.name: fps_message_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 20022 pacs.008 MessageId. Internal FPS message identifier. Max 35 characters. Distinct from fps_reference.

fields.name: settlement_status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: submitted | accepted | rejected | settled | reversed. Transitions: submitted → accepted (Vocalink pacs.002 ACCP); accepted → settled (settlement cycle); accepted → rejected (pacs.002 RJCT).

fields.name: fps_reject_reason_code
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when settlement_status = rejected. ISO 20022 pacs.002 reason code. Max 4 characters (e.g. AC01 = InvalidCreditorAccountNumber).

fields.name: execution_timestamp
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 UTC. Timestamp of FPS submission by SVC-009.

fields.name: acceptance_timestamp
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when settlement_status = accepted.

fields.name: settlement_timestamp
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when FPS intraday settlement cycle confirms.

fields.name: receiving_sort_code
fields.validation_rule: Required. 6-digit sort code of receiving bank (from PaymentIntent.payee_sort_code). Stored for FPS message construction and scheme reconciliation.

fields.name: receiving_account_number
fields.validation_rule: Required. 8-digit account number at receiving bank. Stored for FPS message and reconciliation.

fields.name: amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Denormalised from PaymentIntent.amount. Must match exactly. Immutable.

fields.name: retry_count
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default: 0. Incremented on each FPS submission retry. Maximum: 2 (SVC-009 retry policy). Immutable after final outcome.

relationships.description: PaymentExecution belongs to one PaymentIntent via payment_intent_id FK.

design_decisions.decision: PaymentExecution is a separate entity from PaymentIntent, owned by SVC-009, not SVC-001.
design_decisions.rationale: SVC-009 owns FPS scheme connectivity and settlement lifecycle. SVC-001 owns the customer instruction and account debit. Separating entities allows each service to evolve independently — e.g. adding CHAPS execution as a second PaymentExecution subtype in JRN-028 without modifying SVC-001 schemas.
